display_name: Atomic Mail /agents (JMAP agent-email API, open alpha)
subcategory: agentic-mail substrate via JMAP (no content guardrail)
install_tell: Live open alpha (2026-06-23). JMAP API (RFC 8620/8621) + MCP (Claude Desktop/Cursor) + AgentSkill (Node/Deno/Bun). Autonomous inbox provisioning via proof-of-work (no human signup step). @atomicmail.ai inboxes (distinct from consumer @atomicmail.io). 100% free in alpha.
misconfig_patterns: Substrate-only: no outbound content guardrail whatsoever. Proof-of-work provisioning removes human gate from inbox creation -- agent can self-provision at scale.
Consumer product (atomicmail.io) vs agent API (/agents, @atomicmail.ai) use different domain/TLD. Potential misclassification risk in tooling that conflates them.

active_probe.false_positive_check: Must anchor on /agents path + JMAP/agent language; atomicmail.io root is encrypted consumer mail.

shodan_dorks.disambiguation: ssl.cert.subject.cn:"atomicmail.io" returns consumer product, NOT the agent API

deployment_tells: JMAP server backend (RFC 8620/8621). @atomicmail.ai is the agent-API domain; @atomicmail.io is the consumer mail product.
MCP server for Claude Desktop/Cursor; AgentSkill for Node/Deno/Bun; direct JMAP for any language.
pivot_paths: Proof-of-work provisioning: an agent can mint inboxes programmatically without human involvement -- relevant to abuse/spoof scenarios at scale.
Domain disambiguation: ssl:"atomicmail.io" vs ssl:"atomicmail.ai" selects different products.

competitive_lane.lane: B (API gateway, JMAP) + C; substrate-only (no outbound content guardrail)
competitive_lane.differentiator: Standards-based JMAP instead of proprietary REST; proof-of-work autonomous provisioning; free in open alpha.

shodan_infrastructure.infrastructure_notes: Single OVH VPS Strasbourg. Self-hosted mail stack visible: mx1 (inbound MTA), rspamd (spam filter), mta-sts, sns (likely webhook delivery), grafana (monitoring), health (liveness endpoint). eol-product tag = Shodan detected an end-of-life software component (verify which). rspamd + mta-sts + grafana on a single public IP = early-stage/solo-operator infra pattern consistent with open alpha status.
shodan_infrastructure.security_note: grafana.atomicmail.ai on same IP -- check if Grafana auth is on. eol-product tag warrants a banner grab to identify the EOL component.
